description: This file contains utility functions for telemetry log management, including log file seeking, system load retrieval, configuration initialization, and profile-based log seek tracking. It manages paths, log rotation, and profile-specific seek positions, and includes thread-safe data structures and functions.

methods.name: freeLogFileSeekMap
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a hash map element containing log file seek data.

methods.name: freeGrepSeekProfile
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a GrepSeekProfile structure.

methods.name: freeProfileSeekHashMap
methods.description: Frees memory for a hash map element containing a GrepSeekProfile.

methods.name: addToProfileSeekMap
methods.description: Creates and adds a new GrepSeekProfile to the profile seek map for a given profile name.

methods.name: removeProfileFromSeekMap
methods.description: Removes a profile from the seek map and saves its execution count.

methods.name: removeProfileFromExecMap
methods.description: Removes a profile's execution count and resets its counter.

methods.name: getLogSeekMapForProfile
methods.description: Retrieves the GrepSeekProfile for a given profile name.

methods.name: getLogSeekValue
methods.description: Reads the seek value for a log file from the hash map.

methods.name: updateLogSeek
methods.description: Updates the seek position for a log file in the hash map.

methods.name: getLoadAvg
methods.description: Reads system load average and adds it to a list of search results.

methods.name: fsize
methods.description: Calculates the size of a file stream.

methods.name: updateLastSeekval
methods.description: Updates the last seek value based on the current log file position.

methods.name: getLogLine
methods.description: Retrieves a line from a log file, handling rotation and seek position.

methods.name: updateIncludeConfVal
methods.description: Reads and updates configuration paths from include.properties.

methods.name: initProperties
methods.description: Initializes configuration paths and device type from device.properties.

methods.name: isPropsInitialized
methods.description: Returns whether properties have been initialized.
